'''Eryn Talosa''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Exchange]] leader on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. A Voss commando [[Sama Zo]] put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head.<ref name="BC" />
